summary.name: EroLove
summary.one_liner: EroLove is an 18+ browser-based AI companion site offering fictional adult characters with persistent memory, ready-made roleplay scenes, and group chats of up to four characters.
use_cases: private adult roleplay with a fictional companion
group roleplay with up to four characters
chatting with an AI that remembers past conversations
generating AI photos in chat using sparks
summary.what_it_does: The site offers AI companions that chat in the browser, with personalities and memory that persists across conversations. Users can start pre-written scenes (around 30 listed, e.g. "Last call", "Night train") where the character speaks first. Group rooms hold two to four companions in one thread. Paid features such as photos and voice use a credit system called sparks, sold in packs or included monthly with plans. The site states that explicit content between fictional adults is allowed, with hard limits on minors, real people, incest, non-consent, animals and gore.
notable: Persistent memory the companions show and use across chats
Ready-made walk-in scenes with the character speaking first
Group rooms with up to four companions interacting with each other
Credit-based 'sparks' system for photos and voice
caveats: Premium is $12.99/month or $77.99/year, paid in crypto per the FAQ; free tier is limited to 5 messages a day
Video and calls, and the Devoted tier at $29.99/month, are marked coming soon
Sparks from plans don't carry over; photos and voice cost sparks
